THIS FORM IS REQUIRED OF ALL EXCHANGE STUDENTS (JEP-J AND JEP-E)
Please refer to the explanation provided separately on our website, in your preferred language.
Please be sure to submit this form with your Exchange Application.
日本語能力自己評価表
（Grid for Self-Assessment of Japanese Language Skills ）
以下のサイトにあるCEFRの自己評価表を参考にして、自分の日本語能力を例のように評価してください。
Referring to the CEFR Self-Assessment Grid on the following sites, please rate your own Japanese language ability according to the example below. (An explanation regarding our program specifically is provided separately.)

日本語版 (Japanese Version)
https://jfstandard.jp/pdf/web_reference.pdf  (P68～P69)
ヨーロッパ言語（31言語）版  (31 European Languages)
https://www.coe.int/en/web/portfolio/self-assessment-grid
中国語版 (Chinese Version)
http://www.hjenglish.com/xiazai/p361594/

例）読むこと、書くことはA2レベルまででき、聞くこと、やりとり、表現はB1レベルまでできる場合。
Example) In the case that one's Reading and Writing skills are equivalent to Level A2, and one's Listening, Spoken Interaction and Spoken Production skills are equivalent to level B1.
